entries.0edd69714583fa90: A securities company that operates the equity crowdfunding platform "FUNDINNO," connecting unlisted companies' fundraising with investors' investment in unlisted shares.
entries.140fa0cd74063d4e: The [Description of Business] section states that the group operates across 3 areas—the primary market (primary area), growth support (growth area) and secondary market (secondary area)—as the Unlisted Company Equity Platform Business, and that it is a platform that creates a cycle of unlisted shares.
entries.19ba25629cde6b0d: FUNDINNO PLUS+ (large-scale fundraising support for specified investors)
entries.19e666ba965b96df: Fee income from trading of unlisted shares
entries.19fe2a5701b17323: Individual investors and specified investors investing in unlisted shares
entries.242c90adb7dd801d: The [Description of Business] section states that 'FUNDINNO' is Japan's first equity-based crowdfunding service, that in April 2017 it disclosed information on case No. 1 as Japan's first equity-based crowdfunding offering, and that it holds the No.1 position in Japan on an issuance-amount basis (based on statistics from the Japan Securities Dealers Association).
entries.2da15f6c5df939ee: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥395 million, turning to a profit from a net loss of ¥1,421 million in the prior fiscal year.
entries.39da69afe7738858: This area provides the shareholder and corporate management platform FUNDOOR (including MUFG FUNDOOR, co-developed with Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking Corporation) and provides CxO personnel recruitment support through a consolidated subsidiary. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥286 million.
entries.39f8127960e4819c: This area provides the shareholder and corporate management platform FUNDOOR (including MUFG FUNDOOR, co-developed with Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking Corporation) and provides CxO personnel recruitment support through a consolidated subsidiary.
entries.3bab96d1aa687fbb: This area provides the equity crowdfunding service FUNDINNO, and FUNDINNO PLUS+, a large-scale fundraising support service that uses the J-Ships system for specified investors and shareholder communities.
entries.4a03a71f2ae20493: The company's distinctive position in the industry lies in handling 3 areas, issuance, growth support and distribution, on 1 platform, and completing the circulation of unlisted shares in-house.
entries.4b45aa887ba0e26a: The company provides equity-based crowdfunding 'FUNDINNO', large-scale fundraising support for specified investors 'FUNDINNO PLUS+', the shareholder management platform 'FUNDOOR', recruitment support, and the trading market for unlisted shares 'FUNDINNO MARKET'.
entries.4fa272271f8327fc: Regarding 'FUNDINNO', the company states that it has built advantages across the entire process, including web marketing to attract investors and issuers, a rapid screening system, creative that accurately conveys the appeal and risks of issuers, web marketing in sales, and management of investment funds. It also cites the data on investors and startup companies accumulated through matching funding supply and fundraising since its founding as an advantage, and states that 'FUNDINNO PLUS+' shares the foundation built for 'FUNDINNO', giving it an early launch and high profitability.
entries.51aeffbe73085fe1: Its users are unlisted startup companies seeking to raise funds and individual and specified investors who wish to invest in unlisted shares. Issuers can raise funds in as little as about 3 weeks, and investors can invest in startups from small amounts.
entries.534e6bb0147800d0: Revenue is mainly derived from handling fees for fundraising received from issuers, and also from FUNDOOR usage fees and recruitment support fees. Operating revenue increased from ¥1,184 million in the prior fiscal year to ¥2,501 million in the fiscal year ended October 2025.
entries.55d445a9ce8e1c1d: Its users are unlisted startup companies seeking to raise funds and individual and specified investors who wish to invest in unlisted shares.
entries.56f5942ed8af344c: Regarding the unlisted share market, the company states that the government's 5-Year Plan for Startup Development sets out the creation of an environment for using equity-based crowdfunding and the development of a secondary market for unlisted shares, and that discussions at a forum of the Japan Securities Dealers Association and the Financial Services Agency have addressed expanding fundraising involving market intermediaries. The company states that, as of October 1, 2025, there were 10 association members handling the Specified Investor Issue System (J-Ships), including the company.
entries.587ea34313b0b053: Growth in the primary area, which handles large-scale fundraising, is driving revenue growth. By bringing together growth support and trading markets, the strategy is to complete the entire cycle of unlisted shares on its own platform.
entries.5d6d076096880ab8: This is a single-segment business operating across three areas of unlisted shares: the primary market (primary area), growth support (growth area) and the secondary market (secondary area).
entries.5f46dec4d6ea07d0: Founded in 2015 as Nihon Kuraudo Kyapitaru Co., Ltd. in Minato-ku, Tokyo, the company changed its name to FUNDINNO，INC． in 2022.
entries.680fca71991369b4: With 'Challenge fairly, create the future' as its reason for being, the company is working to build a platform that gives fair access to money, people and information.
entries.6f8bad5a3e277ece: It was a first mover that disclosed the first equity-based crowdfunding offering in Japan in 2017, and holds the No.1 position in Japan on an issuance-amount basis.
entries.75c014090e35d1b5: This area provides the online trading market for unlisted shares FUNDINNO MARKET, which uses a shareholder community system, and FUNDINNO MARKET PLUS+, which began in September 2025 to support large-volume direct transactions.
entries.8c580264aa31170b: The [Management's Analysis of Financial Position, Operating Results and Cash Flows] section states that the increase in operating revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was mainly due to growth in operating revenue from 'FUNDINNO PLUS+', and the [Description of Business] section states that the company is a platform that creates a cycle across the primary market (primary area), growth support (growth area) and secondary market (secondary area).
entries.9191428996b8a975: Listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market
entries.9d996941e7864327: This is a single-segment business operating across three areas of unlisted shares: the primary market (primary area), growth support (growth area) and the secondary market (secondary area). The two companies in the business are the company and its consolidated subsidiary ＦＵＮＤＩＮＮＯ ＧＲＯＷＴＨ Co., Ltd., which provides recruitment support for CxO personnel, and operating revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥2,501 million.
entries.a16d7332ed9ffb9d: Regarding 'FUNDINNO', the company states that it has built advantages across the entire process, including web marketing to attract investors and issuers, a rapid screening system, creative that accurately conveys the appeal and risks of issuers, web marketing in sales, and management of investment funds.
entries.a1a2b395798533db: Handling fees for fundraising received from issuers
entries.a97ea8867deb7e23: Revenue is mainly derived from handling fees for fundraising received from issuers, and also from FUNDOOR usage fees and recruitment support fees.
entries.ab90ac4dafd945ec: Founded in 2015 as Nihon Kuraudo Kyapitaru Co., Ltd. in Minato-ku, Tokyo, the company changed its name to FUNDINNO，INC． in 2022. Listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market in December 2025, and the number of consolidated employees as of October 31, 2025 was 124.
entries.bca15a3db9a14758: With 'Challenge fairly, create the future' as its reason for being, the company is working to build a platform that gives fair access to money, people and information. Aiming for the 'democratization of the unlisted share market' in the medium term and 'replacing the financial market with DX' over the medium to long term, the company states that for the three years from the fiscal year ended October 2025 to the fiscal year ended October 2027, it will work to expand total transaction value (GMV).
